scope: Complete verify_crate_packages.sh runs, including tool preparation, archive packaging, resolver-latest compilation and declared-minimum verification.
decision: Keep compiled source-owner fingerprints for correctness. Skip dependency updates when every declared minimum is already measured at that version, reuse the identical successful build, and independently compile any changed graph. Repeated full audits fell from approximately 209 to 124 seconds on this host.
limitations: Source fingerprints alone did not materially improve full-audit wall time: the repeated baseline and candidate were 208.39 and 208.93 seconds.
Comparing lockfiles after unconditional minimum updates also did not materially improve repeated full-audit time.
The refined selector avoids updates for minimum versions already observed in resolved metadata. It still reads minimum metadata and asserts every declared floor after proving lockfile identity.
First runs include different compilation and AOT preparation work and are not cold-build comparisons.
These constrained-host runs are not GitHub merge-group p90 measurements.
The subsequent compiler-contract file relocation changes the fingerprint but was outside these complete audit measurements; final-source CI must qualify that layout.
